name: instant-worker — billing reconciler gap detected > 3 (15m) [dropped Razorpay webhook]
description: Fires when the billing reconciler finds more than 3 mismatches between Razorpay's live subscription state and teams.plan_tier in a 15m window. instant_billing_reconciler_gap_detected_total is the PRIMARY signal for a dropped Razorpay webhook: each gap = a team whose DB plan_tier disagrees with what Razorpay says they're paying for. Labelled by direction (upgrade = paid but DB stuck on lower tier, the customer-harming case; downgrade = DB still on higher tier after a cancel/downgrade, the revenue-leak case). The companion instant_billing_reconciler_gap_corrected_total tracks the fix; this alert keys on the detection so a steady drip of dropped webhooks is visible even when the reconciler self-corrects each one. P1: user-visible, recoverable. Threshold ABOVE 3 over 15m avoids paging on a single transient race the next sweep would clear. Source: worker/internal/jobs/billing_reconciler.go; counter BillingReconcilerGapDetected in worker/internal/metrics/metrics.go.

nrql.query: SELECT sum(instant_billing_reconciler_gap_detected_total) FROM Metric WHERE service = 'worker' FACET direction
